# zfs mount (share_mount_one, OP_MOUNT, explicit): mounts what create -u
# left unmounted, noauto included; refuses mounted, off, none, legacy, zvols
# covers: mount
zfs create -u $R/a
zfs mount $R/a
zfs mount $R/a
zfs create -u -o canmount=noauto $R/n
zfs mount $R/n
zfs create -u -o canmount=off $R/o
zfs mount $R/o
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none $R/m
zfs mount $R/m
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=legacy $R/l
zfs mount $R/l
zfs create -V 67108864 $R/v
zfs mount $R/v
zfs mount $R/missing
